scope: the flip: version 2 as the production Show path, with the editor, the Show list, fresh Shows, .pxlshow import and the MCP catalogue moving together and the per-record dispatch that keeps an unconverted row consistent
invariants: One Show's editor, history, save queue and command catalogue are the same record version at every instant; no window exists where the editor holds v2 while commands assume v1 (specification section 10).

Nothing in the application rewrites a stored row's version. The operator conversion is the only writer that converts one, so an unconverted row keeps the editor, the vocabulary and the behavior it had before the flip.
The development preview of an unconverted row converts in memory only: no provider call, no row write, and a production build ignores it however the URL is written.
Ordinary version-1 .pxlshow import survives the activation beside version-2 import, and a version-2 record never enters the version-1 `shows` collection.
Discovery before attachment describes exactly one vocabulary, and every surface of that connection - tools, instructions, schema and reference resources, list_commands - describes the same one.
